items.text: – Marmal atá ann. Ciallaíonn marmal an-daor.
items.q: A boy is meant to mispronounce 'marble' and think it means expensive. Is 'marmal' a natural child's slip of 'marmar', still recognizable?
before: Leanaimis orainn ag dul. Bhí teach amháin leath bealaigh ann. Bhí a bhalla go hálainn. Deireadh Ghassem:
